tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phun tshogs lnga ldan gyi khrid ces bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ 'dir rgyal ba rgyal sras chen po'i tshul 'dzin pa/ rin chen snang ba 'odakyi rgyal mtshan ni/ rje btsun shākya mchog ldan gyi zhal snga nas kyi gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig 'di'i go don nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa ni/ dang po so sor thar pa rigs bdun gang yang rung ba dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa legs par blangs/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs/ dam tshig dang sdom pa mig 'bras bzhin du legs par bsrungs/ de nas nyams su blang ba'i rim pa la thun mong ba thabs gtso bor gyur pa'i khrid dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa thabs shes rab zung du 'brel ba'i khrid/ de'i bog dbyung zhing gegs bsal ba'i khrid/ tshogs gnyis rgya cher spel ba'i khrid de bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gsal btab la/ skyabs su 'gro ba la lan gsum bya/ dus 'di nas brtsam ji srid par/ /sdig pa kun las bdag bzlos kyang*/ /lus dang ngag las yid sgo nas/ /dge la rab tu brtson par bgyid/ /ces theg dman dang thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba lan gsum/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems kyis/ /ji ltar byang chub thugs bskyed ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang sems bskyed cing*/ /byang chub spyod pa'ang spyad par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ zhes sogs lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus lha sku gsal stong la sems gtad/ bum dbang ngo*/ /byang chub sems sngags kyi sgra dang bcas pa khar phab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ ngag grags stong la sems gtad/ gsang dbang ngo*/

/de rnams 'od du zhu rang nyid la thim/ rang lus bde bas gang*/ sems stong gsal ba la mnyam par bzhag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ /spros pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral ba'i ngang du cung zad cig bsgom/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de ni sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig gso ba'o/ /de nas bdag dang sems can thams cad nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba la cis kyang mi phan/ shi ba'i tshe shul du lus/ der ma zad 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang mi rtag cing mi brtan/ snying po med pa'i rang bzhin can yin zhes mi rtag pa'i sgo nas 'khor ba yid dbyung bar bya/ de nyid yang bcar gyin bsgom/ thun mjug tu dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo/ de ltar nyin thun gsum/ mtshan thun gsum drug tu bsgom par bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sngon du 'gro bas sdom pa gsum blangs pa ni thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ dge rtsa bsngo ba rjes te 'di gnyis thams cad la 'dra'o/ /de ltar na dmigs skor gcig go /de nas 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can yin te/ ngan song gsum na tshor ba sdug bsngal sran du med/ mtho ris gyi bde skyid mi brtan cing 'jig lus sems la sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa rgyun mi chad pa yod/ las nyon sdug bsngal gsum gyis 'khor lo bskor ba 'di las ci nas kyang thar dgos pa 'dug snyam du sdug bsngal gyi sgo nas 'khor ba mtha' dag la skyo shas drag tu bskyed de dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /lus 'di mi gtsang zhing snying po med pa'o snyam du bsgom pa ni dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /nga zhes bya ba ni/ phyi yul/ nang lus/ bar gang na yang mi gnas pa'i phyir/ bdag ni gang du'ang grub pa med do/ /zhes bsgom pa ni dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /pha mar gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa myong ba'i snying re rje/ 'di rnams bde na/ skyid na snyam pa ni/ byams snying rje'i dmigs skor lnga pa'o/

/sems can 'di rnams byang chub mchog la reg pa'i don du/ bdag sangs rgyas myur du thob par bya'o/ zhes yang yang bsgom pa ni dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /de rnams sngon 'gro'i khrid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas la/ sems spros pa'i mtshan ma/ thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang nas/ kha nang log gi shes pa'i cher gyis bltas pa na/ gzhi gdod ma nas dngos bzung thams cad dang bral zhing gsal ba'i chos mi dor ba/ 'gyur med kyi dbyings la rang ngo shes pa skyong ba ni stong pa nyid bsgom pa ste/ rang rig mngon sum gyi rnal 'byor ye shes kyang*/ bde gshegs snying po bsgoms pa zhes kyang bya/ gnyis med kyi ye shes rang zhal lta ba zhes kyang bya/ yongs grub kyi rnal 'byor zhes zer te dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /rang sems lha sku gsal stong 'ja' tshon dwangs pa la sems gtod pa ni lha sku gsal stong bsgom pa ste dmigs skor brgyad pa'o/ /rlung bum can kha sbyor tu bzung zhing lus khong stod du bsgom pa'i lte ba'i dbus na/ mar me sor bzhi pa khrig khrig g.yo ba/ de g.yo bas lus bde lam lam 'dug pa gcig sgom/ thur sel khong 'dren gyi sbyor bas cung zad bde ba bskyed/ de ni bde ba sgom pa ste dmigs skor dgu pa'o/ /de gsum so so'i la nyams rtags thon na/ rang bzhin 'gyur med brjod bral de kha'i ngang nas/ sems kyi ro bde bar lhang nge ba/ snang cha lha skur lam me ba/ kha nang bltas kyi shes pa dang ma bral ba de kho na bsgom ste/ g.yo med kyi bde chen zung 'jug gnyis med ye shes don dam gyi rnal 'byor 'di ni dmigs skor bcu pa'o/ /de gsum dngos gzhi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sems kyi gsal ba'i nyams la ma zhen cing sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'o/ /de bzhin du bde ba dang stong pa'i nyams la ma zhen pa bya/ bstod pa dang bde ba dang longs spyod phun tshogs rnyed pa la sogs pa rnams la zhen pa dang dga' spro mi bya/

smad pa dang sdug bsngal dang*/ dbul phongs la sogs pa rnams la skyo ba dang mi dga' ba la sogs pa mi bya/ thams cad rmi lam lta bu mnyam pa nyid du shes par bya/ bde sdug dga' mi dga' sogs kyi snang ba ci shar thams cad 'dzin med kyi dbyings su ci thub bsre'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa pha rol du phyin pa drug la rnam pa thams cad du bslab par bya'o/ /zhes dam bca' yang nas yang du bya/ de dmigs skor bcu gcig pa'o/ /de bzhin du bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la slob pa'i dam bca' bya ste/ dmigs skor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /sems can 'di rnams myur du sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god dgos pas/ pha rol phyin pa'i lam yang shin tu 'gor te/ de bas na smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi lam gyis tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya'o/ /zhes dam bca' yang yang bya/ dmigs skor bcu gsum pa'o/ /de gnyis rjes sam yan lag gi chos te sa bcu gsum dang chos mtshungs pa dmigs skor bcu gsum mo/ khrid bzhi po de la ni gzhi chos zhes bya'o/ /gzhi chos kyi snying po ni/ gnas lugs kyi lta ba ngo sprod pa ste/ de'i la gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med par ngo sprod pa/ rang rig ye shes don dam du ngo sprod pa dang*/ de nyid bde chen zung 'jug du ngo sprod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems rang bzhin mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ phyi snang ba la cher gyis bltas pas ngo shes yod ste/ yul dang sems kyis dbye ba'i sa mtshams phyes med do/ /snang ba de nyid rang gi sems yin par gzugs su snang ba lam me ba dang*/ sgrar snang ba lhang nge ba dang*/ de bzhin du dri ro reg byar snang ba thams cad kyang rang sems gcig po de las logs su snang ba med par gtan la dbab pa ste/ ngo sprod pa dang po'o/ /de nas rang sems kyi 'char sgo nyon mongs dang rnam rtog ci shar ba thams cad/

me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gdod ma nas snang la ngos bzung med par ngo shes kyis gtan la dbab/ de ni gzung 'dzin gnyis rang bzhin med par gtan la phab pas ngo sprod gnyis pa'o/ /lus snang dang sems kyi 'char sgo ci byung yang*/ rang snang 'khrul ba tsam las sems kyi rang bzhin la nam yang ma gos par gtan la dbab pa ni/ kun rtog glo bur gyi dri ma gdod nas yod ma myong bar ngo sprod gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems kyi ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba brjod pa'i yul las 'das kyang*/ rang rig rang gsal nam yang rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ yul snang dang rnam rtog ma shar gyi khyad par 'pho 'gyur gang yang med par nyams su myong bas gtan la dbab pa ni/ gnyis med kyi ye shes don dam bden par ngo sprod pa ste/ ngo sprod bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sems kyi snang ba ma 'gags pa/ dag ma dag gi snod bcud kyi snang ba 'char du rung ba ni/ snang stong brjod du med pa'i phyir dag pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de nyid kyi ngo bo 'pho 'gyur gtan nas med pa/ ro bde bar shar ba ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ de gnyis ming 'dogs tha dad ma gtogs ngo bo logs su med par rig pa skad cig ma gcig po 'di'i steng du gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ rang sems zung 'jug tu bstan pa ste/ ngo sprod lnga pa'o/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga mtshon pa'i ngo sprod rim pa lnga'o/ /de ltar na gzhi chos dang snying po ngo sprod de/ phun tshogs lnga ldan gyi khrid ces bya'o/ khrid dang po gnas phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste/ yon tan thams cad skyed pa'i gzhi yin pas so/ khrid gnyis pa ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste/ de nyid gtso bo yin pas so/ khrid gsum pa dus phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste/ gegs sel zhing bogs thon pa dus kyis mchog yin pas so/ khrid bzhi pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste/ gnyis pa'i 'khor yin pas so/

khrid lnga pa chos phun sum tshogs pa dang 'dra ste/ gtso 'khor de gnyis kyis nyams su myong bya yin pas so/ /de ltar na 'di la phun sum tshogs lnga ldan gyi khrid ces pa'i rgyu mtshan de dag yin pas so/ /zhes pa 'di ni sde snod 'dzin pa chen po dpal ldan shākya bstan 'dzin dang smra ba'i dbang po blo gros dpal bzang dang rab 'byams smra ba kun dga' blo gros kyis kyang bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //bkra shis/ bṛ ya tsha/ zhus so/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ phun tshogs lnga ldan gyi khrid ces bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 258 -- PAGE 259 -- PAGE 253 -
